structure: Part 24, Document drop zone and guidance. Read in full: drop-zone.fit.spec.js (6 tests) and guidance.fit.spec.js (4 tests), and all 10 trace zips the partition names. The Playwright trace CLI tim installs refused every zip (TraceVersionError: the traces were recorded by a newer Playwright), so each trace was read from its already-extracted contents in this part's working folder (t01..t10, matched to the zips by the title in each 1-trace.trace), rendering DOM snapshots with a jq renderer (html.jq) and reading test.trace steps and 1-trace.network requests with jq. Trace short names used in refs: T1 drop-zone e323e (offers a drop zone), T2 drop-zone c8d9b (no file chosen live region), T3 drop-zone b6ba8 (dropped file), T4 drop-zone a3b58 (single input named file), T5 drop-zone 53b15 (failed attachment on the zone), T6 drop-zone 1b9b1 (drop zone axe), T7 guidance b120e (what to attach, above the form), T8 guidance 33e3d (closed expander), T9 guidance 390b7 (GOV.UK link new tab), T10 guidance 3bec6 (expanded guidance axe). Every trace signs in, starts a notification, unlocks sections by walking Origin of the import, What are you importing?, Commodity details and the Overview (other parts' pages), then follows the Overview link 'Upload documents' to one page: /live-animals/notifications/{reference}/accompanying-documents, title 'Upload documents - Import notification service - GOV.UK', caption 'Documents', h1 'Upload documents'. Page skeleton in order: back link to the notification overview; Draft tag and notification reference strip; empty JS error-summary container; caption and heading; guidance paragraph and 'Other documents you may need' bullet list; a govuk-details expander holding a two-column table and a GOV.UK link; a multipart form (data-max-file-size 10000000) containing a 'File upload' summary card with Document reference, Document type, Date of issue (MOJ date picker) and Attachment (govuk-file-upload drop zone) fields, a 'Save and add another' button and 'You have not added any documents yet.'; then Save and continue, Save and return to overview and Cancel and return to overview. States seen: enhanced empty drop zone (T1, T4, T9, T10), chosen file named (T2, T6), dropped file named (T3), details open (T8 end, T9, T10), server-rendered pre-enhancement markup (T7 and T8 last snapshots), and the error state after an empty 'Save and add another' (T5: POST returns 400, title gains 'Error: ', four-item error summary). Conditional: the expander table is hidden until opened; error messages only after a failed submit. Not covered here: the other fields' own behaviour beyond the copy they show, an uploaded document list, scan statuses, and every file validation other than 'no file'.

claims.statement: Before JavaScript enhances it, the server renders the Attachment field as a plain visible file input with id 'file' and name 'file' and the same accept list, so the field works without JavaScript; enhancement moves the id 'file' to the drop zone button and renames the input 'file-input'.
